subject: RM_Rattlegrope
departures: no head, mantle, eyes or beak: the whole creature is a knot of tentacle-like limbs and nothing else
the limbs are tangled and knotted into one another at the centre, not radiating cleanly from a body
a round blue nodule sits at the tip of every limb
the limbs reach up and grope into open air on dry land, not hanging limp or trailing underwater
